name: Permission drift
short_description: Permission drift is the gradual divergence of an access model from current business reality as access keeps evolving through local decisions, role changes, leftover groups and exceptions that are never removed.

evidence.quote: Signal three, identity and permission drift, define the real org.
What typically happened is simple. Permissions drifted over time.
It transforms permission drift from an invisible background noise into an amplified liability.
Permission drift is the slow, silent erosion of your access control model.
Permission drift is the quiet twin of semantic drift.
Failure mode two, permission drift in agent access.
Permission drift is not loud. It is patient. It waits.
